T: Pizza down the grate. Never pay full price if it's late.
D: Four mutant turtle brothers and their rat sensei take on the Foot Clan from the sewers of New York.
P: Order the pizza when the delivery guy can't find 122 1/8.
S: Pinwheels of dough, red sauce, pepperoni and mozzarella, baked golden. Pizza dude's got 30 seconds.

Roll 500g pizza dough into a thin rectangle. Spread with 150ml pizza sauce, cover with 80g sliced pepperoni and 150g grated mozzarella. Roll up tightly from the long side, slice into 12 rounds and place cut side up on a lined tray. Bake at 220C for 15 minutes until golden.
April's garlic knots with chilli oil butter
Tied dough knots baked hot and tossed in garlic, parmesan and chilli oil butter. Better than her frozen pizza.

Cut 500g pizza dough into 16 strips, tie each in a knot and prove on a lined tray for 30 minutes. Bake at 230C for 12 minutes. Melt 60g butter with 3 crushed garlic cloves and 1 tbsp chilli oil, toss the hot knots through it and finish with 30g finely grated parmesan.
Fresh mozzarella torn over charred sourdough with chilli oil, cracked pepper and basil. Very wise, very old school.

Take 2 balls of fresh mozzarella (about 250g each) out of the fridge 30 minutes before serving. Warm 3 tbsp honey with 1 tsp chilli flakes until runny. Brush 8 slices of sourdough with 2 tbsp olive oil and char on a hot grill pan, 2 minutes a side. Tear the fresh mozzarella over the toast, spoon the chilli oil over, crack pepper on top and finish with a handful of basil leaves.
M: Thin crust pepperoni pizza with chilli oil poured on at the table. Cowabunga.

Divide 1kg pizza dough into 2 balls and stretch each thin on an oiled tray. Spread each with 150ml pizza sauce and scatter 250g grated mozzarella between them. Cover with 200g thin pepperoni slices so they curl into cups as they bake. Bake at the oven's highest setting, 10 to 12 minutes, until the edges char. Warm 3 tbsp honey with 1 tsp chilli flakes and pour it over at the table with a handful of basil.
Casey Jones hockey stick hot dogs
Foot-long franks griddled till blistered, slow-cooked onions and yellow mustard.
Fry 2 sliced brown onions slowly in 2 tbsp oil for 20 minutes until soft and brown. Griddle 4 foot-long franks until blistered. Serve in 4 buttered long rolls with the onions and yellow mustard.
W: Chocolate chip cookie baked in a pizza tray, chocolate drizzle and candy, cut in wedges.

Beat 125g soft butter with 150g brown sugar and 1 egg, then mix in 200g plain flour, 1/2 tsp bicarb soda and 150g choc chips. Press into a greased pizza tray and bake at 180C for 15 minutes. Drizzle with 50g melted chocolate and scatter 100g lollies over the top. Cut into wedges.
K: Fresh green apple and lime juice over ice, topped with soda. April O'Neil, Channel 3 news.
Blend 3 green apples with the juice of 2 limes and 200ml water and strain. Divide over ice in 4 glasses and top with 800ml soda water.
